known_differences.description: fsci-integrate implements solve_ivp (RK23, RK45, DOP853, Radau, BDF, LSODA), odeint, solve_bvp, quad, cubature, simpson, and trapezoid.

threats.description: Stiff ODE systems integrated with explicit RK methods suffer step-size collapse unless switched to implicit Radau/BDF or LSODA.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/api.rs:1189 (solve_ivp): supports Radau IIA, BDF, and automatic nonstiff/stiff switching in LSODA, plus step-floor termination.
threats.strict_mode_response: Switch automatically in LSODA or terminate when step falls below machine spacing.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Record solver choice and step failures in OdeSolverPortfolio / AuditLedger.

threats.description: Mismatched x and y array lengths or non-monotonic grid spacing in composite Simpson / trapezoid quadrature.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/quad.rs:1321 (simpson): validates matching sample and coordinate lengths and non-empty slices.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(IntegrateValidationError) on length mismatch or empty slice.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite samples and length mismatches fail-closed.

threats.description: Non-finite integrand values in adaptive Gauss-Kronrod quadrature causing infinite interval subdivision.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/quad.rs:256 (quad): short-circuits subdivision when non-finite integrand values are encountered and enforces limit cap.
threats.strict_mode_response: Terminate adaptive subdivision at limit or non-finite evaluation.

threats.description: Legacy odeint wrapper (tfirst=false default) argument order drifting from solve_ivp (t, y).
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/lib.rs:169 (odeint): preserves SciPy odeint (y, t) callback convention and time-grid interpolation.
threats.strict_mode_response: Evaluate RHS at (y, t) and return trajectory at requested t points.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate finite initial state and time grid before integration.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: empty initial state y0 or mismatched RHS dimension
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return IntegrateValidationError and emit FailClosed audit event.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Short-circuit adaptive subdivision or reject trial step.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Fail closed and record audit event.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: mismatched x and y lengths in sample quadrature

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return QuadResult with error estimate and convergence status.
